clues.it: Tea era nella 1ª riga, accanto a una criocapsula e in una stanza diversa da Olga.
clues.en: Tea was in the 1st row, beside a cryopod and in a different room from Olga.

clues.it: Giada era nella 5ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Giada was in the 5th column, in the 2nd row and north of Carla.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 6ª colonna, accanto a un fascio di cavi e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 6th column, beside a cable bundle and north of Anna.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Carla era nella 5ª riga, accanto a una grata e a nord di Olga.
clues.en: Carla was in the 5th row, beside a floor grate and north of Olga.

clues.it: Luca era nel Criosonno, ma non era accanto a un'antenna.
clues.en: Luca was in the Cryo Bay, but was not beside an antenna.

clues.it: Olga era nella 1ª colonna e sul Ponte di Comando, ma non era accanto a un droide.
clues.en: Olga was in the 1st column and on the Command Deck, but was not beside a droid.

clues.it: Anna era accanto a un reattore e nella stessa stanza di Carla.
clues.en: Anna was beside a reactor and in the same room as Carla.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a un droide e in una stanza diversa da Tea.
clues.en: Irene was beside a droid and in a different room from Tea.
